{{Top}} {{Update|[[Star Wars Helmet Collection 70]], [[The Grand Army of the Republic (reference book)|The Grand Army of the Republic]]}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:Commander_Wolffe_Rebels.png]] |option1=4 BBY |image2=[[File:Wolffe-SWE.png]] |option2=20 BBY |name=Wolffe
CC-3636 |homeworld=[[Kamino]]{{Databank|clone-commander-wolffe|Clone Commander Wolffe}} |birth=c. [[32 BBY]], Kamino''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[The Lost Commanders]]" to [[4 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Visual Guide: Epic Battles]]'' states that Wolffe is 28 [[Standard year|year]] when he meets the [[Spectres]] in that episode. Therefore, he was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[32 BBY]]. |death= |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |donor=[[Jango Fett]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |height=1.83 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|ft]]}} |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]], later white |feathers= |eyes=Brown {{C|right eye lost}} |skin=Tan{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}} |cyber=[[Cybernetics|Cybernetic]] right [[eye]] |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[104th Battalion]] *[[Galactic Empire]]{{EncyclopediaCite|The Grand Army of the Republic}} **[[Recovery Strike Team]]{{TBB|Extraction}} *[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|70|Helmets}} **[[Phoenix Cell]] **[[Lothal resistance group]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|The Separatists have no regard for innocent life. They don't care who walks away from war and who doesn't. That's why we move on them now, Commander…and Wolfpack leads the hunt.|Wolffe|[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 2|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 2]]}} '''Wolffe''', formerly designated '''CC-3636''', was a veteran [[Clone Commander]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] with [[Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. The leader of the [[104th Battalion]]'s famed [[Wolfpack]] [[squad]], [[Commander]] Wolffe proved to be tireless in his efforts against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], displaying an affinity for strategy. On his first mission with Koon, Wolffe served on board the [[Jedi Master]]'s [[flagship]], the ''[[Triumphant]]'', when Koon led a [[Fleet|task force]] to eliminate the Separatist [[warship]] ''[[Malevolence]]''. While [[Battle of Abregado|confronting]] the ''Malevolence'' in the [[Abregado system]], all the troopers from the Wolfpack who were on board the ship were [[Death|eliminated]], save for Koon, Wolffe, [[Clone Sergeant]] [[Sinker]], and [[trooper]] [[Boost]]. The four were rescued by [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], and Wolffe had his unit adopt new [[Phase I clone trooper armor|clone trooper armor]] in honor of his fallen comrades. Refusing to let the loss of the Wolfpack deter him from his service, he inspired loyalty amongst his men. During the [[Battle of Khorm]], Wolffe lost his right [[eye]] in a fight with the [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]], and he subsequently wore a [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] eye replacement and retained facial scars. Wolffe continued his military service to the Republic, undertaking several key missions with Koon, working with Skywalker and Tano again during a [[First Battle of Felucia|battle]] on [[Felucia]], [[Mission to Vanqor|rescuing]] Skywalker and Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]] on [[Vanqor]], and helping a Republic strike team [[Battle of Lola Sayu|escape]] with rescued prisoners from [[Lola Sayu]]. He personally oversaw a [[Mission to Aleen|supply mission]] to the [[groundquake]]-devastated planet [[Aleen]], assisting in [[Battle of Kadavo|liberating]] [[Togruta]] slaves from the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]] on [[Kadavo]], and took part in a mission that recovered the [[lightsaber]] of the late Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas]]. In the aftermath of the Clone Wars and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY]], Wolffe continued his military service in the [[Imperial Military|army]] of the new regime. During or after [[18 BBY]], Wolffe led a [[Recovery Strike Team]] to the planet of [[Teth]] in order to capture the rogue clone [[Omega]] for the Imperial [[Advanced Science Division]] and was unknowingly pitted against his former friend and comrade [[Rex|Captain Rex]] and his [[Clone Underground]] movement. After several intense firefights and despite his orders, Wolffe ultimately decided to let Rex, along with Omega and the remnants of his Clone Underground movement to escape from Teth. Fifteen years after the end of the Clone Wars, Wolffe was retired and was living in a [[Rex's AT-TE|modified]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TE]] on [[Seelos]] with Captain Rex and [[Clone commando]] [[Gregor]]. At one point, the group was visited by the [[Spectres]], a Rebel group that was [[Galactic Civil War|combating]] the [[Galactic Empire]]. Wolffe initially distrusted the group, which included the [[Great Jedi Purge]] survivor [[Kanan Jarrus]] among their number. Believing that the rebels were a threat, Wolffe sent a transmission that was picked up by the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]], alerting the Empire of the rebel presence. However, Wolffe came to see reason when Rex spoke up for the rebels and told him they were not a threat. Under Rex's command, Wolffe and Gregor held back Kallus's [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT walkers]] so that the rebels could escape. Following the battle, he and Gregor stayed behind on Seelos while Rex joined the rebellion. In [[1 BBY]], Wolffe and Gregor joined rebel forces on [[Lothal]] and contributed to the [[Liberation of Lothal|liberation]] of the planet. ==Biography== ===Early life=== CC-3636, eventually known by the name Wolffe, was [[Cloning|cloned]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] like every clone in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]].''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' By the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]],{{Databank|clone-captain-rex-biography-gallery|Clone Captain Rex Biography Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}} establishes that the [[Battle of Christophsis]] is a short [[time]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' stated was the start of the [[Clone Wars]]. As [[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 1|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 1]] establishes that the siege of [[Hisseen]] occurs before the Battle of [[Christophsis]], it must be a short time after the Battle of [[Geonosis]] as well. As ''Battle Tales'' 1 shows [[Clone Commander]] Wolffe serving under [[Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon]], Wolffe must have been assigned to him during the early war. he was stationed on Kamino and served as a [[Clone Captain]]. He broke up a fight between [[Heater (clone trooper)|Heater]], a trooper who had at one point deserted the army, and another trooper who had called him a coward for doing so. Wolffe talked with Heater and gave him command of a [[Heater's squad|squad]] of deserters, including clone troopers [[Sync]], [[Charlie]], and [[Racetrack (clone trooper)|Racetrack]], telling them they would be free to make their decision concerning their continued service after they completed one mission together. The unit was sent to [[Assault on a Separatist weapons depot|attack]] and destroy a [[Separatist weapons depot]], where the squad came together, completed the mission, and decided to continue serving the Republic.[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 4|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 4]] Some time later, Wolffe became a [[Clone Commander]] and served under [[Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon]]. Wolffe led the [[104th Battalion]] and its [[Wolfpack]] [[squad]]. At some point, Wolffe flew an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter]] near [[asteroid]]s and in [[Space warfare|space combat]].{{FFGXW2|set=ARC-170 Starfighter Expansion Pack|cardname="Wolffe"}} Wolffe and his troops fought in many battles over the course of the war. The unit was also given missions that pulled them to non-frontline duties at times as well.{{Databank|clone-commander-wolffe|Clone Commander Wolffe|oldversion=20231202154048}} ===The Clone Wars=== ====Mission to Quarmendy==== [[File:WolfpackFightsOnNexus-TCWBattleTales2.png|thumb|left|160px|Wolffe leading his men to attack the Nexus]] Early on in the Clone Wars, Koon sent Wolffe and three Wolfpack troopers [[Boost]], [[Clone Sergeant]] [[Sinker]], and [[Clone Corporal]] [[Comet (clone trooper)|Comet]] on a mission to infiltrate the [[Nexus]], a floating city and trading outpost that had fallen to Separatist forces led by [[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]]. Dropped off by [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]] [[pilot]] [[Corvis]], they approached the Nexus with [[JT-12 jetpack]]s. However, when Tambor's forces were breached by their incursion, he destroyed the city as to not allow it to be controlled by the Republic. Despite the loss, Koon showed gratitude to Wolffe for making sure all members of the squad survived and for rescuing a citizen from the city, [[Orkle]]. ====Siege of Hisseen==== Some time later, Wolffe, Koon, and the Wolfpack were sent as part of the Republic's [[Siege of Hisseen]] alongside Jedi Generals [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and their clone commanders, Commander [[Cody]] and Captain [[Rex]].[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 1|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 1]] When the Jedi were drawn away from the battle to confront [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]] and his [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]], Koon attempted to contact Wolffe, but his communication was obstructed by the mountain range. After Wolffe only heard garbled instructions about the [[Hisseen's parliament|Hisseenian parliament]], Koon instead sent coordinates to Boost, and Wolffe deduced that they were being sent to rescue the parliament members. [[File:CloneTroopsAtGunpoint-TCWBattleTales5.png|thumb|right|210px|Wolffe alongside Captain Rex and Commander Cody]] Joined by Cody, "[[Boil]]," "[[Waxer]]," and members of the [[212th Attack Battalion]], Wolffe and the others successfully freed the prisoners.[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 3|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 3]] However, in the meantime, Rex and the others were being overrun. Just as their lines were breached, Wolffe and the others arrived to temporarily salvage their position,[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 4|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 4]] but the droids captured them. As they were about to fire, Skywalker, Kenobi, and Koon arrived to save them. With the battle won, the Republic forces returned to Coruscant at the request of Master Yoda.[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 5|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 5]] ====Lost at Abregado==== {{Quote|Thanks for getting us out of there in one piece, General Skywalker.''"
"''You have my Padawan to thank for that. She always said you guys would pull through.''"
"''General Plo said someone would come for us. We're glad he was right.|Wolffe and Skywalker|audio=WolffeThanksSkywalker-RM.flac|}} [[File:Wolffe_Koon.jpg|thumb|left|250x250px|Wolffe and Koon plan their attack on the ''Malevolence''.]] Some months into the Clone Wars, Wolffe and Koon were dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] to investigate a series of surprise attacks on Republic [[fleet]]s which always left no survivors by the [[Confederacy military|Separatist military]] leader, [[General]] [[Grievous]], in his [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]], the ''[[Malevolence]]''. Wolffe, the 104th, and Koon set out aboard the ''[[Triumphant]]'', with two other [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] as support, and soon tracked the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system]]. Wolffe informed Koon that the ''Malevolence'' had spotted them and had reduced its speed, prompting Koon and Wolffe to report their position and request reinforcements from the nearest Republic military presence: the fleet of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and his [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], who were in the nearby [[Bith system]]. However, the [[HoloNet]] signal was lost when the Separatists [[Jammer|jammed]] the signal shortly before they began their surprise attack in what became known as the [[Battle of Abregado]].{{SideshowCite|set=Sixth Scale Figures|pack=Wolfpack Clone Trooper (104th)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Wolfpack-Clone-Trooper-104th-Star-Wars-Sixth-Scale.asp}} The ''Malevolence'' fired its secret [[superweapon]]: a massive [[ion cannon]]. The ion blast engulfed all three [[Star Destroyer]]s and shut down all the systems and equipment; leaving them dead in [[Realspace|space]]. The now defenseless fleet fell under [[turbolaser]] fire from the ''Malevolence''. Koon, realizing the fleet was lost, ordered the evacuation of the ''Triumphant''{{'s}} crew to its [[escape pod]]s. Wolffe, Koon, Sinker, and Boost boarded an [[Republic escape pod|escape pod]] and ejected into space just as the ''Triumphant'' exploded; turning the fleet into a graveyard and killing all of the Wolfpack—save Wolffe, Sinker, and Boost. [[File:WolffeKoonSinkerBoost-RM.png|thumb|right|250px|Wolffe, Plo Koon, and his squad trapped inside one of the escape shuttles]] The group, alone drifting in the debris field, were unsure that anyone would come rescue them, except Koon, who maintained faith. Soon thereafter, Wolffe learned the pod's power grid was down, leaving them with little [[Oxygen|air]] and no way to contact help. Koon reasoned that if they got the power restored they would survive long enough to be found, assuring them that if they worked together they would survive. Just then, another pod appeared through their pod's [[viewport]], but the group realized that the clones within had already perished—their pod had been breached by [[B1-series rocket battle droid|rocket battle droids]] manning a [[Droch-class boarding ship|boarding ship]]. The clones were floating dead in the vacuum of space. Disturbed by the sight, Boost and Sinker quickly restored the power, so Wolffe could man the [[Comm unit|comm system]] to search for rescue craft. However, he quickly picked up a distress signal from another pod, [[Pod 1977]]. The clone officer on the comm only had a second to shout that the battle droids were attacking them and hunting down survivors. Wolffe made visual contact with the pod just as the droids cut into the pod and killed the troopers; leaving only Koon, Wolffe, Sinker, and Boost as the sole survivors of the battle. The droids spotted the group's pod and headed towards it, forcing Koon to quickly decide to meet the enemy face-to-face—his [[Antiox breath mask|breath]] [[Breath mask|mask]] and Boost and Sinker's [[Phase I clone trooper armor|armor]] would protect them from the airless environment. Wolffe, however, who was wearing no armor, remained inside the pod to ensure the distress signal would continue broadcasting. The Jedi and the two troopers fought the droids, who had latched on to the pod with the boarding craft's pincers and activated the "squeeze" feature on the boarding craft that began to damage the pod. Wolffe picked up a signal from [[Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and her master General Skywalker, who had come to search for survivors. Wolffe informed Koon that the Jedi were coming, and Koon then ordered him not to lose the signal as the droid's craft damaged the pod enough that it began to lose pressure. Koon destroyed the craft using [[Plo Koon's lightsaber|his lightsaber]] and the Force, defeating the droids. Koon, Boost, and Sinker remained outside of the doomed pod to allow Wolffe more oxygen as he used his [[Midi-chlorian|connection]] to [[the Force]] to relay their position to Tano. She and Skywalker quickly located them, and Skywalker used a [[Magnetic harpoon|tow cable]] to pull the pod into the hold of his [[freighter]], the ''[[Twilight]]''. [[File:Wolffe_recovers.png|thumb|left|250px|Wolffe recovering aboard the Twilight]] Skywalker popped the viewport from the pod [[Telekinesis|using]] the Force, allowing Wolffe, who was coughing and weak from a lack of oxygen, to sit and rest while a [[2-1B surgical droid]] tended to the weakened clones. Grievous, at the helm of the ''Malevolence'', after learning the rocket droids had been killed, returned to the debris field to locate the survivors, wanting to prevent Republic forces from communicating information about his warship. Koon, Skywalker, and Tano, in the ''Twilight's'' [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], shut down all the ship's systems and Skywalker's [[astromech droid]], [[R2-D2]]. However, the 2-1B surgical droid, [[TB-2]], was not shut down and remained tending to Wolffe, and the ''Malevolence'' picked up the signal from the droid and fired an ion blast at the ''Twilight'' as a result. Skywalker, however, a prestigious [[pilot]], used his skills to escape the debris field, evade the ion blast, and enter [[hyperspace]] just in time. The ''Twilight'' rendezvoused with Skywalker's fleet, and aboard the ''[[Resolute]]'', Wolffe thanked Tano and Skywalker for rescuing them, glad that Koon's faith had come to pass. ====Losing an eye==== Some time later, the Wolfpack Battalion's ranks were replenished with new troopers.{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} Wolffe and his battalion participated in a [[Battle of Khorm|battle]] on [[Khorm]], where he fought alongside Skywalker.{{ForceCollection|Clone Commander Wolffe|star=4}} During the fighting, Wolffe was permanently scarred when Ventress cut his right [[eye]], leaving a long scar across the right side of his face. He later had a silver [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] replacement installed.{{TCW|Holocron Heist}} Despite his injury, Wolffe continued to serve and lead his troops. ====Rescue missions==== {{Quote|They made it through the first wave. Concentrate all fire on the cruiser on the left.|Wolffe commands the Republic fleet during the battle over Felucia|audio=WolffeBattleOfFelucia-HH.flac|}} [[File:WolffeFelucia-HH.jpg|thumb|right|250x250px|Wolffe giving orders]] Following the Battle of Khorm, the Wolfpack and Koon were deployed on the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer ''[[Negotiator]]'' to break the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Separatist navy's]] [[blockade]] of the planet [[Felucia]]. The Republic forces, led by Obi-Wan Kenobi, Skywalker, and Tano, had been overwhelmed by the droid army, so Koon led a group of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|Low Altitude Assault/infantry]] [[gunship]]s and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]]s through the blockade in order to rescue Skywalker and his troops. Meanwhile, Wolffe oversaw the space battle against the Separatist [[battleship]]s and [[starfighter]]s. Wolffe directed the clone [[gunner]]s to target and destroy the Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. Meanwhile, Koon and the rest of the Wolfpack extracted Skywalker, Tano, Kenobi, and the clone troopers, bringing them to safety aboard the ''Negotiator''. They then returned to Coruscant, having completed the rescue mission. Sometime after that mission, despite the maroon markings used before the massive blow to their ranks by the ''Malevolence'' having been retained up to that point, Wolffe and the 104th{{TCW|Padawan Lost}} decided to adopt an armor color scheme of blue-grey instead of retaining the maroon. The new grey markings served as remembrance of those lost in the Battle of Abregado. Following's Grievous's [[Capture of Eeth Koth|capture]] of [[Eeth Koth]], Wolffe discovered a coded message from Koth that told him that Grievous was heading to [[Saleucami]].{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}} Wolffe then assisted Plo Koon and Ahsoka in rescuing Windu and Skywalker from the wreckage of the ''[[Endurance]]'' on [[Vanqor]]. He also went with Koon to rescue Skywalker's, Kenobi's, and Ahsoka's team from the [[Citadel]] on [[Lola Sayu]]. The strike team was successfully rescued, giving the Republic access to the [[Nexus Route]] coordinates.{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} [[File:BattleOfFelucia-Planning.jpg|thumb|left|243x243px|Skywalker, Koon, Wolffe, and Tano plan their attack on the Separatist outpost]] Some time later, Wolffe and his squad received some armor upgrades and took part in a [[Second Battle of Felucia|attack]] on a [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)|Separatist outpost]] on Felucia, commanded by Grievous. However, while everyone was distracted by the ongoing battle, Commander Tano was captured by a [[Trandoshan]] hunter and was brought to the [[Trandosha]]n [[moon]] [[Wasskah]], where the Trandoshans used to hunt sentient beings for sport. After the battle on Felucia was over, the group noticed Commander Tano was missing and Anakin launched a search to find her, with no results. Much to Skywalker's dismay, Koon had their forces pull out of the area, with Wolffe and the other clones loading into gunships and departing. However, a Wookiee relief force aided by bounty hunters rescued Tano and her fellow Jedi friends and brought them back to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. ====Mercy mission to Aleen==== {{Quote|Here's how it is. My ''orders'' are to deliver supplies and re-establish power and communication systems. Report back to the transport the moment that R2 unit has completed the download. Tell them we'll be out of their hair in no time.|An impatient Wolffe, to C-3PO, the translator for the Aleena|audio=WolffeImpatient-MM.flac|{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}}}} [[File:Wolffe_TVC.jpg|thumb|right|142px|Wolffe on Aleen]] En route to stop the Confederacy's [[annexation of the Qiilura system]], Wolffe was ordered by Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and Master [[Yoda]] to drop off relief supplies to [[Aleen]] to help the [[Aleena]]. Wolffe also had Amidala's protocol droid, [[C-3PO]] and Skywalker's astromech, R2-D2, much to his annoyance. Once on Aleen, Wolffe spoke with King [[Manchucho]] and set up stations for their supplies. After the mission, Wolffe and his men then dropped the droids off with Master [[Adi Gallia]]. Wolffe then boarded General Grievous' ship with Plo Koon and his men to rescue Gallia. Wolffe then found C-3PO and R2-D2 and took them back to their ship.{{TCW|Nomad Droids}} ====Rescue mission on Kadavo==== {{Quote|That's everyone. We have to go. The facility's breaking up!|Wolffe, to Ahsoka Tano|audio=WolffeKedavoRescue-EFK.flac|{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}}} [[File:RescueMissionKadavo-EscapeFromKadavo.png|thumb|left|250px|Wolffe following the rescue mission of Kadavo]] Wolffe then went to the [[Zygerrian]] [[Zygerrian Slave Empire|Slave Empire's]] [[Kadavo slave processing facility|processing facility]] on [[Kadavo]] with Koon and Admiral [[Barton Coburn]]. He then assisted in rescuing Kenobi, Rex, Skywalker, Tano, and [[Kiros]]'s [[Togruta]]s from plunging to their deaths. Upon Tano's recommendation to bring the [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Hand of Justice]]'' under the facility, Coburn instructed Wolffe, Sinker, Comet, and a few other Wolfpack troopers to head to the top of the ''Hand of Justice'', with jetpacks and cabled guns. While Skywalker, Kenobi and Rex fled the facility on a gunship, the Togrutas climbed down the Wolfpack's ascension cables to the top of ''Hand of Justice''. However, a few Togrutas did not grab the cables and started to freefall, only for Tano, Wolffe and the Wolfpack to catch them, landing them safely on the ''Hand of Justice''. They all fled safely to the interior of the cruiser, with Koon ordering the remaining gunships to open fire on the facility after the ''Hand of Justice'' departed. Wolffe then attended the Republic's [[Republic strategy conference|strategy conference]] at [[Valor (space station)|Valor]] along with Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]], Kenobi, Skywalker, Commander Cody, Clone Commander [[Neyo]], and several Republic admirals.{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}} ====Finding Ahsoka==== {{Quote|We're taking you in now, Commander.''"
"''That's ''not'' going to happen, trust me. Now, I'm not going to hurt any of you… ''We're'' not going to hurt any of you, but you're ''not'' taking me in.''"
"''Commander, we ''are'' taking you in.|Wolffe and Ahsoka Tano, the latter refusing to be arrested alongside Asajj Ventress|audio=WeAreTakingYouIn-TCaJ.flac|{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}}} [[File:WolffeCornersFugitives-TCAJ.png|thumb|right|250px|Wolffe and his Coruscant Guard troopers corner Tano and Ventress.]] Wolffe then took a squad of [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]] to Coruscant's [[Coruscant Underworld|underworld]] to find Ahsoka Tano and ascertain if she was really behind the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing]] at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]]. Although Tano had saved his life earlier in the war, he was determined to follow orders. During his search, he found Tano with Dooku's former assassin Asajj Ventress, who had since become a bounty hunter. He tried to take them both, but was subdued by Ventress. Wolffe later found Tano at [[Level 1315]]'s [[Abandoned munitions warehouse|warehouse]] and stunned her. Nearby, he found a crate full of [[NM-K reconstitutor|nano-droids]], the same devices used in the bombing of the Jedi Temple, leading him to assume that Tano was the one responsible. Tano was expelled from the Jedi Order and turned over to the Republic for trial, but was ultimately cleared of any wrongdoing after Anakin Skywalker identified Padawan Barriss Offee as the true culprit.{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}} ====Search on Oba Diah==== {{Quote|The hull shows substantial scoring and wear. Whenever it crashed, it wasn't recently. General Plo, the scans check out. It's a T-6 shuttle, all right, serial number 775519.''"
"''I want the entire area cleared. We're taking everything back to Coruscant.''"
"''Everything?''"
"''Everything!|Wolffe and Plo Koon, as the latter comes across Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber in the wreckage of the shuttle|audio=EverythingEverything-TLO.flac|{{TCW|The Lost One}}}} [[File:KoonWolffeFind775519-TLO.png|thumb|left|250px|Koon and Wolffe examine the wreckage of Sifo-Dyas's T-6 shuttle on the Oba Diah moon.]] When a [[distress signal]] was picked up from the ship thought to have belonged to Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas]], Plo Koon, Wolffe and the Wolfpack were dispatched to the desert moon of [[Oba Diah]]. There they fought their way through the howling winds of severe sandstorm in search of the [[T-6 shuttle|shuttle]] that once belonged to the Jedi Master. As they searched, Comet insisted over comlink that the moon was a wasteland and there was nothing there. Wolffe replied that all their intel pinpointed to the shuttle being there and they needed to continue their search. Soon after, Sinker detected a faint signal on the scanners inside a [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut|clone turbo tank]]. Standing behind Wolffe and Sinker, Koon confirmed that was Sifo-Dyas's shuttle. As they fought their way through the sandstorm and the remains of the shuttle, Wolffe remarked the shuttle showed substantial scoring and wear. He also confirmed that the shuttle had been there for a long time. Koon found [[Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber]] and told Wolffe he wanted the entire area cleared, with everything being brought back to Coruscant. Wolffe later wrote an intelligence report on [[D1-series aerial battle droid]]s for "[[Neyo's Almanac of Clankers]]," a survival compendium that listed notable battle droids.{{GermanFanCite|118|Database}} He then went to [[Ord Mantell]] with [[Aayla Secura]] where they found evidence linking the recent [[Battle on Ord Mantell|battle]] to former Sith Lord [[Maul]]'s [[Shadow Collective]].[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]] ===Imperial service=== ====Mission on Teth==== [[File:WolffeLeads-TBB-Extraction.png|thumb|right|265px|Wolffe and his team confronting Clone Force 99 on Teth]] During or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|306}} Wolffe led a [[Battle on the B'omarr Order Monastery|mission]] to the planet [[Teth]] in order to assist the [[clone assassin]] [[CX-2]] recover a high-value Imperial target, a young clone named [[Omega]]. CX-2 had discovered the [[Clone Underground]]'s base of operations at the [[B'omarr Order Monastery]], and Wolffe led a [[Recovery Strike Team]] of [[clone commando]]s, [[TK stormtrooper]]s, and [[clone stormtrooper]]s to assist in Omega's capture.{{TBB|Infiltration (episode)}} Wolffe was unaware that the insurgents that he had been sent to capture were clones, specifically members of the Underground and the rogue clone squad known as the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]]. Arriving on Teth, Wolffe did not appreciate CX-2's unwillingness to obey his orders, but he nonetheless made progress in pursuing the clones, performing a pincer maneuver on the enemy as they tried to escape. Omega and members of the Underground and the rogue clone squad known as the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] eventually fled into the jungle, but when they were ultimately caught, Wolffe realized the nature of their enemy, seeing the group of clones and even recognizing [[Rex]], who removed his helmet and pleaded with Wolffe to let them go. Rex insisted that Wolffe knew that his orders were wrong, and that Omega was just a kid and did not deserve to be hunted. Wolffe argued with Rex initially, but eventually ordered the clones under his command to stand down, allowing the rogue clones to leave the planet. ===A soldier no longer=== ====A new life==== {{Quote|Didn't you hear? The Emperor said the clone army has out-served its purpose and retired us. Now we spend our days just telling stories and sling for joopas.|Rex describes his, Gregor and Wolffe's life under the Empire|audio=SlingForJoopas-TLC.flac|{{Rebels|The Lost Commanders}}}} [[File:Wolffe-4-retina_92972cde.jpg|thumb|left|263x263px|Wolffe, Rex, and Gregor go outside to meet the rebels]] Wolffe eventually removed his [[behavioral modification biochip]]. In the years after the Empire's [[Proclamation of the New Order|birth]], Wolffe was living with Captains Rex and [[Gregor]] in a [[Rex's AT-TE|modified]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TE]] on [[Seelos]], having managed to remove their control chips that forced them to follow [[Order 66]]. ====Encounter with the Spectres==== {{Dialogue|Rex|Boys, this might be it. At least we'll go down fighting like a clone should.|Gregor|I'm with you all the way, Captain.|Wolffe|«Howls»|attr=Rex, Gregor, and Wolffe prepare to battle the Empire|audio=RelicsMakeAStand-RotOR.flac|src=}} Several years before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Wolffe made sure that Rex was unaware of transmissions from his old friend, Commander Tano. They were then contacted and approached by the [[Spectres]] rebel cell, who had been sent by Ahsoka Tano to acquire locations of [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] bases for the rebellion. When [[Kanan Jarrus]] identified the clones and drew his lightsaber, Wolffe identified him as a Jedi and assumed he had come for revenge, prompting him to open fire on the Jedi. Rex managed to break up the fight before [[Ezra Bridger]] revealed that Ahsoka Tano sent them. Wolffe later privately discussed whether or not to aid the rebels with his brothers, fearing retribution from the Empire if they did so. Unbeknownst to his brothers, Wolffe secretly tipped off the Empire to the presence of a Jedi on Seelos, believing the rebel presence was a threat to them. [[File:Wolffe_commanding_AT-TE.png|thumb|right|250px|Wolffe charges the AT-TE towards Kallus' AT-AT's legs]] Subsequently, Wolffe drove the AT-TE as the clones and ''Ghost'' crew went hunting for [[joopa]]s, using [[Garazeb Orrelios]] as bait. After successfully luring and killing the joopa, Jarrus desired to get their intel and leave, though Rex convinced him to stay for dinner. As [[Sabine Wren]] was granted access to the clones' database, she discovered that one of them has alerted the Empire. Rex realized Wolffe tipped them off, who regretfully admitted to alerting the Empire to protect his comrades from persecution for helping the Jedi, as well as having hidden the messages that Tano had sent Rex. Rex then managed to convince him that the Empire was the enemy. Subsequently, they discovered a [[Viper probe droid|probe droid]] had been spying on them before Rex shot it down. Afterwards, the group prepared for an imminent attack from the Empire. While the Spectres urged the clones to come with them and join the Rebellion, Wolffe and his fellow clones insisted on staying behind to delay the Imperials so that the ''Ghost'' crew could escape. During the [[Assault on Seelos|Imperial assault]] on Seelos, Wolffe and his companions rode their AT-TE into battle against Agent Kallus' three [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT walkers]]. Despite being outnumbered and outgunned, the clones were determined to go down in a blaze of glory. However, Bridger convinced his fellow rebels to turn around and help the clones. Flying the ''Phantom'', the rebels succeeded in hijacking one of the AT-AT walkers and used it to immobilize the other Imperial walkers; forcing Agent Kallus and his surviving crew to retreat into the desert.{{Rebels|Relics of the Old Republic}} Following the battle, Rex joined the Rebellion whilst Wolffe and Gregor stayed behind on Seelos, taking the remaining AT-AT walker for their new home.{{RebelsRecon|Jdj4teY5gik|#2.06: Inside "Wings of the Master" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-wings-of-the-master}} Wolffe and Gregor continued to live on Seelos in their new AT-AT, naming it [[Joopa Base]].{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} {{RPGseed}} With their newly acquired AT-AT, Wolffe and Gregor salvaged Imperial codes from the stolen walker. They notified [[Hera Syndulla]] about the codes, but were attacked by two Imperial AT-ATs before the codes could be sent. As Wolffe and Gregor, aboard Joopa Base, were being chased down by the walkers,{{SWIA|set=Tyrants of Lothal|rulebook=1}} a team of rebels that included former clone trooper [[Wildfire (clone trooper)|Wildfire]]{{SWIA|set=Tyrants of Lothal|mission=Sands of Seelos}} landed their shuttle on one of the walkers and breached it. The rebels commandeered the AT-AT and used it to destroy the other walker, successfully saving the clone commanders. Wolffe then contacted the rebel team; thanking them and transmitting the stolen codes on an encrypted channel. The codes were then brought to the Spectres, which Sabine Wren determined could be used for a while before the Empire would catch on. {{Endgame}} ====Helping the Lothal rebels==== {{Quote|Hey, Wolffe. Can you believe it?''"
"''What?''"
"''The wolves! You got your Wolfpack back!''"
"''Yeah. They fight just like the boys.|Gregor and Wolffe witness the Loth-wolves attacking stormtroopers|audio=WolfPackBack-AFH.flac|}} [[File:Hera_mustering_allies.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Wolffe joins Hera to help liberate Lothal]] In [[1 BBY]],The [[Liberation of Lothal]] occurs in [[1 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Wolffe and Gregor then met with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] General Hera Syndulla, Captains Kallus, [[Hondo Ohnaka]], Rex, and bounty hunter [[Ketsu Onyo]]. There they asked them to join them in [[Liberation of Lothal|liberating]] Lothal from the Empire. Both Wolffe and Gregor agreed to join them, with Wolffe reasoning that he had followed Jedi into battle before. After sneaking past the Lothal's blockade, Wolffe, Gregor, and Kallus then assisted Ezra and the others in capturing Governor [[Arihnda Pryce]] and defeating her forces, who had assaulted the [[Lothal resistance group]]'s [[Lothal cliff dwelling|cliff base]]. ====Liberation of Lothal==== During the liberation of Lothal, Wolffe stayed behind at the Lothal rebel base with [[Mart Mattin]] and [[Cikatro Vizago]] in order to pick up General Syndulla and the other rebels once they had completed their mission to launch and destroy the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Dome]], the center of Imperial power on Lothal. Wolffe and his comrades were attacked and knocked out by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] "[[Assassin|pet]]," [[Rukh]]. However, they were saved by the [[White Loth-wolf]]. However, Rukh stole their [[LAAT/le patrol gunship|patrol transport]].{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}} [[File:WolffeGregorWolfpack-AFH.png|thumb|right|250px|Gregor and Wolffe watch as the Loth-wolves help route the Imperial forces.]] After awakening, Mart revealed to Wolffe and Vizago that Ezra had assigned him a secret mission. The rebels departed aboard the ''Ghost'' and flew into Lothal's upper atmosphere where they transmitted a signal on [[Frequency Zero]]. Though Wolffe expressed skepticism, Mart convinced him and Vizago to trust Ezra's plan. This drew a large pod of [[purrgil]], which wiped out Thrawn's [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]]. While Wolffe and Vizago initially did not grasp Ezra's plan, they believed that it would work because it had "Ezra written all over it." After the purrgil carried Ezra, Thrawn, and the ''Chimaera'' away into the depths of space, Wolffe informed Sabine that there were no Imperial ships left in space. Wolffe, Mart, and Vizago then evacuated the surviving rebel strike team after they succeeded launching the Dome, a mobile [[Imperial Planetary Occupation Facility]], into Lothal's atmosphere and detonating the Imperial base. This ushered the end of Imperial rule on Lothal. Despite this victory, Wolffe and Rex's comrade Gregor perished during the fighting in the Dome. === Legacy === Rex wrote about Wolffe in his book ''[[The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]''.''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]'' ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I, I contacted the Empire. If they found out that we were helping Jedi, they'd wipe us out. ''[…]'' I wanted to protect you guys, protect our squad.''"
"''The war is over. We are free men. We can't live under the fear of the Empire for the rest of our lives, Wolffe. That's not freedom.''"
"''They're not our enemy. I'm sorry.|Wolffe and Rex|}} [[File:CC-3636-Vanqor.png|thumb|right|200px|Wolffe in his custom Phase I armor.]] Wolffe was a [[Clone Commander]] who was bred from a template of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]]. Standing at 1.83 meters (6 feet) tall, he had [[Color|black]] hair and brown eyes. He lost his right eye during a skirmish with the Sith apprentice Asajj Ventress. and covered it with a silver patch. Wolffe was a practical strategist and competent commander with naval combat experience, having served aboard the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer ''Triumphant''. Wolffe was also calm and displayed fortitude even in the midst of crisis. Despite being wounded, Wolffe refused to abandon his duty as a soldier. He often used dual DC-17 hand blasters in combat. Wolffe developed a sense of respect for the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano after they saved his life during the Battle of Abregado. As a clone commander, Wolffe was bred for combat and naturally favored combat operations over relief missions. Wolffe complied with orders to lead a relief mission to Aleen, but found his escort the [[protocol droid]] C-3PO annoying and fastidious. Wolffe also had little appreciation for the eccentric customs of the Aleena species and disregarded [[King]] Manchucho's beliefs in the underground [[Kindalo]] dwellers as nonsense. Following the bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar, Wolffe and his men took part in a manhunt for Tano through Coruscant's Underworld. Upon discovering the Padawan near a crate of nano-droids, he assumed she was guilty and [[stun]]ned her with his blaster, despite her pleas for him to let her explain. [[File:Wolffe-CTRaF.png|thumb|left|200px|Wolffe's fourth armor set was his upgrade to Phase II.]] Since he removed his control implant, Wolffe was no longer able to be forced into complying with Order 66. Following the Clone Wars, Wolffe and his two comrades Rex and Gregor settled on Seelos and lived in a vintage AT-TE walker. He and Gregor looked up to Rex as their natural leader. Wolffe did not want to have any dealings with the wide galaxy and hid messages that Tano had sent to Rex. Wolffe had an unpleasant initial encounter with the former [[Great Jedi Purge]] survivor Kanan Jarrus and believed that the Jedi had come for revenge; only the timely intervention of Rex prevented the escalation of hostilities. While Rex and Gregor befriended Jarrus and his rebel comrades, Wolffe remained aloof and suspicious of the newcomers. Believing that the presence of Jarrus and his Jedi apprentice Ezra Bridger endangered him and his fellow clone veterans, Wolffe secretly contacted the Empire. When Rex pointed out the errors of his way, Wolffe ultimately accepted Rex's chastisement without bitterness. He made up for his transgression by joining forces with Rex and Gregor to hold back [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus's]] AT-AT walkers so that the Spectres could escape. Wolffe came to respect Bridger and Jarrus after the two returned to save him and his clone comrades from being destroyed by Kallus. Wolffe's sense of loyalty to the Jedi led him, Gregor, and Rex to participate in Ezra's plan to liberate Lothal. While Wolffe initially did not grasp Ezra's plan to use a pod of purrgil to attack Thrawn's fleet, he believed that it would work because it had "Ezra written all over it." ==Skills and abilities== [[File:Wolffe-SCSP.png|thumb|right|300px|Wolffe piloted an ARC-170 starfighter.]] As a clone commander, Wolffe knew how to operate a blaster rifle and an AT-TE walker. He also wore a [[jetpack]] during the Battle of Felucia. While Wolffe was a seasoned soldier, he was no match for the Force powers of Asajj Ventress, who trounced him and his men. Wolffe was also a competent pilot and was able to pilot an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter]] at one point{{FFGXW2|set=Siege of Coruscant Scenario Pack|cardname="Wolffe"}} and the [[VCX-100 light freighter]] ''[[Ghost]]'' during the Liberation of Lothal. ==Behind the scenes== Wolffe was created for the [[Cartoon Network]] animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which ran from [[2008]] to [[2013]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voiced all the other clone troopers in the series. Wolffe first appeared in the episode "Rising Malevolence," which premiered on [[October 3]], 2008. Baker reprised his role as Wolffe in the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. Though ''Rebels'' confirmed that as with Rex and Gregor, Wolffe was able to remove his control chip and was not forced to follow Order 66, ''The Clone Wars'' writer [[Henry Gilroy]] speculated at Dragon Con [[2018]] that Wolffe likely followed the command for a while.{{Twitter|StarWarsExplain|status/1035606443339251713|Star Wars Explained|quote=According to Henry Gilroy, Wolffe likely carried out Order 66 and removed his chip afterwards. 🤭|archivedate=20200814220914}} According to Gilroy, Wolffe removed his chip after the event was done, but the programming and the trauma were still inside him, explaining his aggressive reaction upon seeing Kanan Jarrus for the first
